svg.title: Journal quotation: hang the opening mark
svg.desc: Only the first quotation line shifts left. Font, wording, line breaks, baselines, photo/crop and presentation remain fixed. Close-ups repeat the exact artifact at a larger view scale with explanatory dashed guides. Fictional examples; photographs previously generated with AI, typography authored separately.
svg.text: BEFORE · Opening mark occupies the column
DETAIL · Dashed guide is explanatory only
AFTER · Words share the column edge
